items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Yeah, and I loved Liza, you know, and they played that about... He told me. Alexander Right Time Band.

ctx.x: Yeah, and I loved Liza, you know, and they played that about... You see, they take water at the place where it was. And I went up and I said, what's the name of that piece? He told me. Alexander Right Time Band. And that ain't been the date. That's an old number. That's an old number.
Do you remember a carnet player, Buddy Bolden? Did he ever get down there on excursion or anything?
